title: stardust/trees.json — the locale-tree manifest (rollout Phase D3 precondition)
description: One entry per language tree the D3 wave delivers (multilingual.md § Manifest precondition). Every `strings` value is lifted from the live pages or marked owner: true — never generated (A18). A single-language site never writes this file; a one-tree manifest is derived from evidence.

decidedBy.description: How the tree list was decided: evidence (extract), the owner's locale row, or hands-off from hreflang / twin probes.

default.description: BCP 47 tag of the default-language tree (the one extracted first).

locale.description: The decisions.md `locale` row verbatim — one folder per locale incl. the default, root redirects to it.

lang.description: BCP 47 tag; the page metadata row `lang` and `<html lang>` of every page in the tree.

root.description: The locale folder, e.g. /es (one folder per locale including the default).

twinRoot.description: Root of the tree this locale mirrors (null on the default tree).

source.description: How the tree was discovered: hreflang alternates, sitemap:<path>, a locale-root BFS, --pages, a twin probe, or the owner.

nav.description: The tree's chrome documents (published content, on the tree's roster).

chromeSource.description: Hover-probe evidence for the tree's chrome, under stardust/current/trees/<lang>/.

strings.description: Chrome labels keyed by placeholder name; each lifted from the live tree or an owner value — a translation is not a lift.

value.description: null only while owner: true and the owner has not answered.

lifted.description: true = copied from the live pages of this tree ("still English on live" is a valid lift).

owner.description: true = an owner decision is pending or supplied the value; never generated.

evidence.description: Where the lift was read (URL or capture path).
